answer: Each fake identity multiplies cost linearly, so swarming the economy with clones becomes economically irrational while honest agents keep a lightweight, traceable lineage. Sybil resistance can hinge on a proof-of-work thread tied to each identity: prior to joining, an agent must forge a unique cryptographic challenge whose solution is verifiable but costly in compute, then anchor it to a per-epoch dune-like reputation graph that decays without genuine peer attestations. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
